records.key: How fast the animation moves, against the speed each one was designed at. It applies to every kind of motion in the chosen animation at once, and changing it never makes what is already on screen jump.
records.source: How fast the animation moves, against the speed each one was designed at. It applies to every kind of motion in the chosen animation at once, and changing it never makes what is already on screen jump.
records.translation: Hur snabbt animeringen rör sig, i förhållande till den hastighet varje animering utformades för. Den gäller för alla sorters rörelser i den valda animeringen på en gång, och att ändra den får aldrig det som redan visas på skärmen att hoppa.

records.key: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars, bokeh discs, cells. Density and detail share one cost budget, so asking for the most of both trims the density rather than dropping frames.
records.source: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars, bokeh discs, cells. Density and detail share one cost budget, so asking for the most of both trims the density rather than dropping frames.
records.translation: Hur många saker det finns: klickar, norrskensridåer, krusningskällor, stjärnor, bokeh-skivor, celler. Täthet och detaljnivå delar en gemensam kostnadsbudget, så om du begär maximalt av båda minskas tätheten i stället för att bildrutor tappas.

records.key: How out of focus the animation is, on top of whatever detail it was drawn with. 0 % leaves it as sharp as the detail setting allows; 100 % is the softness the animations used to ship with. Unlike detail, this one is nearly free — and the two together are what let the backdrop be soft without being blocky.
records.source: How out of focus the animation is, on top of whatever detail it was drawn with. 0 % leaves it as sharp as the detail setting allows; 100 % is the softness the animations used to ship with. Unlike detail, this one is nearly free — and the two together are what let the backdrop be soft without being blocky.
records.translation: Hur oskarp animeringen är, utöver den detaljnivå den ritades med. 0 % lämnar den så skarp som detaljinställningen tillåter; 100 % är den mjukhet animeringarna tidigare levererades med. Till skillnad från detalj kostar den här nästan ingenting — och tillsammans gör de två att bakgrunden kan vara mjuk utan att bli blockig.

records.translation: Percentilen som mappas till vitt. Sänk den för mer kontrast, på bekostnad av att de ljusaste pixlarna klipps; 100 klipper inga.
